sources.title: GitHub - marwanelamami/marwanelamami
sources.snippet: The core problem is a compression and systems one: take a model that was trained at scale, and make it fast, small, and accurate enough to run locally on constrained hardware. That means quantization (INT8/FP16), pruning, knowledge distillation, and runtime optimization using frameworks like ONNX Runtime and TFLite.
